'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jim Li LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: heavy shorthand, expanded only where the abbreviation has a single meaning

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
